name: Simone Lin
tagline: AI-driven computational neuroscience, physiological signal processing, and behavioral modeling.

research.statement: I am a biomedical engineer and neuroscience researcher with a background in computational modeling, AI-driven data analysis, and physiological signal processing. My current doctoral research focuses on developing automated pipelines for biomechanical analysis, applying contrastive learning and deep learning representations to clinical neural and behavioral data, and pushing the boundaries of translational neurophysiology.
